definitions.explanation: A flat piece of copper metal, used in construction, art, and crafts.

examples.japanese: {銅板|どうばん}で{屋根|やね}を{葺|ふ}く。
{神社|じんじゃ}の{屋根|やね}には{銅板|どうばん}が{使|つか}われていることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Copper plates are often used for shrine roofs.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{風雨|ふうう}にさらされた{銅板|どうばん}の{屋根|やね}は{美|うつく}しい{緑青色|ろくしょういろ}に{変|か}わり、{独特|どくとく}の{風格|ふうかく}を{醸|かも}し{出|だ}す。
examples.english: A copper plate roof exposed to years of wind and rain turns a beautiful verdigris green, creating a distinctive elegance.

notes:
A compound of {銅|どう} (copper) and {板|ばん} (plate, board). Copper plates are widely used in traditional Japanese architecture, especially for roofing shrines and temples. Over time, copper develops a characteristic green patina ({緑青|ろくしょう}) that is considered beautiful and is a hallmark of aged Japanese architecture.

{銅板|どうばん} is also used in metalworking and printmaking ({銅版画|どうはんが}, copperplate engraving).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銅板|どうばん}{葺|ぶ}き: copper-plate roofing
- {銅板|どうばん}の{屋根|やね}: copper roof
- {銅板|どうばん}{加工|かこう}: copper plate processing
- {銅板|どうばん}レリーフ: copper plate relief

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鉄板|てっぱん}: iron plate; steel plate — thicker and heavier, used for cooking and construction
- {銅版画|どうはんが}: copperplate engraving — a printmaking technique using etched copper plates
- {金属板|きんぞくばん}: metal plate — the general term for any metal sheet
